newsitem.title: FINLAND: RAUTAKIRJA SEES 1996 PROFIT AT 1995 LEVEL.
newsitem.headline: RAUTAKIRJA SEES 1996 PROFIT AT 1995 LEVEL.

text.p: Finnish retail group Rautakirja Oy said on Thursday it expected net sales to fall short of a five percent growth target in 1996 and that cost savings would keep the full-year profit at the level of 1995.

"As a consequence of the development in the early part of the year and the sale of fast wholesaler Merkur, net sales will fall short of the target but as a result of the cost savings actions started, the result is estimated to remain the the 1995 level," the company said in a statement with its January-August results.
In January-August, the group posted a 111.4 million markka profit before extraordinary items, down from 113.6 million.
In 1995, it posted a 195.3 million markka profit before extraordinary items and its net sales were 3.28 billion markka.
